attrs.about: The ahead-of-time compiler: `bun compile`, `bun build --compile --aot`, `bun run --aot` and `compile.aot` in `Bun.build()`. Included in `"cli"`. An executable built with `aot` doesn't need it to run.
`Bun.Archive`, and everything else that reads or writes a tar archive.
also: unpacking packages in `bun install`, and `bun pm pack`
installing a missing package during `bun build` or `bun compile`

attrs.about: Brotli in `node:zlib`, `CompressionStream`, `DecompressionStream` and `fetch`. Without it, `fetch` doesn't offer `br` in `Accept-Encoding`.
`bun:jsc` and `node:v8`.

`bun build`, `Bun.build()`, HTML imports and the development server in `Bun.serve()`, with the CSS parser and the React Compiler. `Bun.Transpiler` doesn't need it, and neither does importing TypeScript or JSX files at run time.

`bun check`, `--check`, and type checking and declaration files in `bun build` and `Bun.build()`. Included in `"cli"`. It shares the type checker with `"lint"` and `"aot"`, so keeping any of the three keeps the type checker.

The whole `bun` command line: the package manager, the test runner, `bun build`, `bun lint`, `bun fmt`, `bun check` and the ahead-of-time compiler. Includes `"lint"`, `"fmt"`, `"check"`, `"install"`, `"aot"`, `"repl"`, `"create"`, `"upgrade"` and `"run"`. An executable only uses it with `BUN_BE_BUN=1`, with `--help` in `BUN_OPTIONS`, or when it calls `Bun.build()` with `check` or `compile.aot`.
`Bun.color()`.
`Bun.Cookie`, `Bun.CookieMap` and `request.cookies` in `Bun.serve()`.
`bun create` and `bun init`. Included in `"cli"`.
`Bun.cron()`. Included in `"spawn"`.
`Bun.CryptoHasher`.
`Bun.CSRF`.
`alert()`, `confirm()` and `prompt()`, which read from the terminal.
`Bun.dns` and `node:dns`. Without it, `fetch()`, `Bun.connect()` and `node:net` still resolve host names, but `node:net` doesn't emit `lookup` and `node:dgram` only takes IP addresses.
Bun's HTTP client: `fetch()`, `Bun.fetch()` and `Bun.FetchSession`. `Request`, `Response` and `Headers` don't need it. Neither does `http.request()` in `node:http`, which needs `"sockets"`.
`bun:ffi` and its C compiler. Included in `"native-code"`.
`bun fmt`. Included in `"cli"`. It shares about 8 MB of code with `"lint"`, so keeping either one keeps that code.
`Bun.FileSystemRouter`.
`Bun.Glob`.
`Bun.hash()`, `Bun.sha()` and the hash classes from `Bun.MD4` to `Bun.SHA512_256`. `Bun.CryptoHasher` has its own name, `"crypto-hasher"`.
`HTMLRewriter`.
`node:http2`, and HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 in `Bun.serve()`.
HTTP/3 in `Bun.serve()`, and `node:quic`.
`Bun.Image` and `.image()` on a `Blob`.
The debugger: `--inspect`, `BUN_INSPECT` and `node:inspector`. An executable built with `aot` also needs `compile.inspector` before a debugger can attach.

The package manager: `bun install`, `add`, `remove`, `update`, `link`, `unlink`, `pm` and its subcommands, `patch`, `outdated`, `publish`, `audit`, `why`, `prune`, `dedupe`, `info` and `bunx`. Included in `"cli"`. `-i`, `--install` and `install.auto` in `bunfig.toml` need it.

Everything that runs code that isn't in the executable: the JavaScript parser, the interpreter and the transpiler. `eval()`, `new Function()`, `import()` and `require()` of files that weren't compiled into the executable, `Bun.Transpiler`, `Bun.plugin()`, and built-in modules that your code doesn't import all need it. `trim` only removes it from an executable built with `aot`.

All of `Intl`, plus `localeCompare()`, `toLocaleString()`, `toLocaleDateString()` and `toLocaleTimeString()`, with their locale data. Includes `"intl-segmenter"`. On macOS, Bun uses the system's ICU, so this is only the bindings.
`Intl.Segmenter` and its dictionaries. Included in `"intl"`. On macOS, the dictionaries come with the system.

IPC with the parent process that started the executable with `ipc` or `fork()`: `process.send()`, `process.disconnect()`, `process.channel`, `process.connected`, and the `"message"` and `"disconnect"` events. Without it, the executable runs as if it was started without an IPC channel.
The JIT compilers for JavaScript, regular expressions and WebAssembly. An executable built with `aot` never starts them, so `trim` removes them. Without `aot`, `trim` keeps them.
`Bun.JSON5`. Importing a `.json5` file doesn't need it.
`Bun.JSONC`. Importing a `.jsonc` file doesn't need it.
`Bun.JSONL`.
`bun lint`. Included in `"cli"`.
`Bun.markdown`. Importing a `.md` file doesn't need it.
Native addons: `.node` files, `process.dlopen()`, N-API, and the V8 and libuv symbols that addons link against. Included in `"native-code"`.

Everything that loads native code: `bun:ffi`, `process.dlopen()`, `.node` addons, and `Database.loadExtension()` in `bun:sqlite`. Includes `"ffi"` and `"native-addons"`. Without it, `loadExtension()` throws an `SQLiteError`. On macOS, `"sqlite"` loads native code too: the system's SQLite library.
`node:crypto`.
`node:vm`.
`Bun.password`.
`Bun.plugin()`.
`process.kill()`. Without it, the executable can't send a signal to any process, including itself.
`process.report`, the Node.js diagnostic report. It lists environment variables, loaded libraries and network interfaces.
The CPU and heap profilers, heap snapshots and code coverage: `--cpu-prof`, `--heap-prof`, `Bun.generateHeapSnapshot()`, `v8.writeHeapSnapshot()` and the profiling functions in `bun:jsc`.
`Bun.redis`, `Bun.RedisClient` and `--redis-preconnect`.
`bun repl`. Included in `"cli"`.

The rest of the command line: `bun run` with `package.json` scripts and `--filter`, `bun exec`, `--help` and shell completions. Included in `"cli"`. The executable doesn't need it to run its own program.
`Bun.s3`, `Bun.S3Client`, and `s3:` URLs in `Bun.file()`, `Bun.write()` and `fetch()`. Without it, an `s3:` URL throws an `Error` whose `code` is `"ERR_FEATURE_REMOVED"`.
also: receiving an S3 file from another process

`Bun.serve()`, and the `node:http` and `node:https` servers, which are built on it. Without it, their `listen()` emits an `"error"` event. `fetch()`, `http.request()`, `node:net` and `node:http2` don't need it.
`Bun.$`, the shell. Included in `"spawn"`.

`Bun.listen()` and `Bun.connect()`, and everything that opens or accepts a connection through `node:net`: `net.connect()`, `net.createServer().listen()`, `node:tls`, `node:http2`, `http.request()` and `https.request()`. `fetch()`, `WebSocket`, `Bun.serve()`, `Bun.SQL` and `Bun.redis` don't need it.
Source maps: the ones that the `sourcemap` option embeds in the executable, which stack traces use, and `SourceMap` and `findSourceMap()` in `node:module`.

Everything that starts a process: `Bun.spawn()`, `Bun.spawnSync()`, `node:child_process`, `node:cluster`, `Bun.$`, `Bun.cron`, `Bun.WebView`, `Bun.Terminal`, `Bun.openInEditor()`, `process.execve()`, `--watch`, `--hot` and automatic crash reporting. Includes `"shell"`, `"cron"`, `"webview"` and `"terminal"`.
also: `bun` commands that start processes, such as `bun run` and `bunx`

BoringSSL — Google's OpenSSL fork. Provides TLS, all crypto primitives, and the x509 machinery that node:crypto needs.
Brotli — high-ratio compression. Backs the `br` Content-Encoding in fetch and bun's --compress bundler flag.
c-ares — async DNS resolver. Backs node:dns and the Happy Eyeballs logic in bun's HTTP client. Async is the point — libc's getaddrinfo blocks.
Google Highway — portable SIMD intrinsics with runtime dispatch. Used by bun's string search (indexOf fastpaths), base64 codec, and the bundler's chunk hashing.
libdeflate — fast deflate/gzip/zlib codec. Faster than zlib for one-shot compression (no streaming). Used by Blob.gzip() and bun's .gz asset loader.
libjpeg-turbo — the de-facto JPEG codec. Backs Bun.Image JPEG decode/encode via the high-level TurboJPEG API (turbojpeg.h).

libuv — cross-platform async I/O. Bun uses it on Windows ONLY, for the event loop and file I/O (Windows' IOCP model needs a proper abstraction layer). On unix, bun's event loop is custom (kqueue/epoll direct).
libwebp — Google's reference WebP codec. Backs Bun.Image WebP decode/encode plus the SharpYUV RGB→YUV converter the encoder prefers.
lol-html — Cloudflare's streaming HTML rewriter. Powers `HTMLRewriter` in bun and Workers.
ls-hpack — HPACK header compression for HTTP/2. Litespeed's implementation; faster than nghttp2's for our workloads.
ls-qpack — QPACK header compression for HTTP/3. Litespeed's implementation, sibling to ls-hpack. Used by lsquic for HTTP/3 header encoding.
lsquic — Litespeed's QUIC and HTTP/3 implementation. Powers Bun.serve's `http3: true` listener.
mimalloc — Microsoft's memory allocator. Bun's global malloc replacement on Linux and macOS, and the JS heap allocator everywhere.
Node.js headers — for N-API compatibility.
picohttpparser — tiny HTTP parser. Single .c file, no build system.
SQLite — embedded SQL database. Backs bun:sqlite and node:sqlite.
TinyCC — small embeddable C compiler. Powers bun:ffi's JIT-compile path, where user-provided C gets compiled and linked at runtime.

zlib-ng — next-generation zlib with SIMD-accelerated CRC, adler32, hash, and chunk operations across SSE2/AVX2/AVX512/NEON. Runtime CPU detection picks the fastest path. Backs node:zlib and gzip Content-Encoding.
Zstandard — fast compression with a good ratio/speed tradeoff. Backs bun's install cache and the `zstd` Content-Encoding in fetch.
